findings.passage: According to @DHS, approximately 278,000 non-citizens are registered to vote in federal elections. Hundreds of millions of U.S. voter records are in the hands of foreign governments. Deceased individuals remain active on our voter rolls. Yet we continue to hold elections without requiring voter ID. We must pass the SAVE America Act. It is our last hope for securing our democracy. Election security is national security.
findings.note: X post by Fuller, quoted by NewsChannel 9 (WTVC), published 2026-07-17, posted after a Thursday (July 16) presidential address on election security. He raises non-citizen registration, foreign access to voter records, deceased voters on the rolls, the lack of a voter ID requirement in federal elections, and calls for passing the SAVE America Act. The same story says he posted again after midnight calling for its passage.
subjects: proof of citizenship to register (SAVE America Act)

findings.motion: On passage, H.R. 8800, National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2027 (Roll Call 278)
findings.note: Clerk roll call shows Fuller voting Yea on final passage; the bill passed 216 to 212. The Rules Committee page (https://rules.house.gov/content/vote-no-404) describes the House rule for this bill as providing that in the engrossment of H.R. 8800 the Clerk shall add the text of the SAVE America Act, as passed by the House, which is a documentary proof of citizenship and voter ID bill. Fuller's own press release on this vote does not mention the SAVE America Act. His vote on the rule itself was not found.
